bestiary_menu.doc: The bestiary menu (M2-UI-02; docs/kb/tech/ui.md section Bestiary). Rects are top-left x, y, w, h at the 1920 x 1080 reference. 'list' is a MenuPage metrics block (the same keys as battle_hud.json commands).

portrait.doc: M2-UI-26: the foe's live portrait (BestiaryPortraitSlot) in the height the page leaves, square in its bottom-right corner, between min_px (hidden below) and max_px. A never-Read foe is a silhouette in theme role silhouette_role at silhouette_alpha.
